text: Two venues trade the same pair.
One on Base Sepolia, one on Unichain.
When they disagree, someone gets hurt.
Second Guard is a reactive contract on Reactive Lasna.
It watches a swap on both chains, holds both prices in its own state, and measures the gap.
A single dump pushes the Base venue thirty two percent away from its twin.
The rule fires in the same second, and both venues stop.
The gap was twenty seven hundred basis points.
The guard recorded the source block, and both chains carry the same number.
Just one rule, living on chain, measured end to end in under two seconds.
